name: NCAA D-III East Regional Cross Country Championships
where: South Portland, ME · host Bates · Wainwright Sports Complex
headline: NCAA D-III East Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 9 MIT won the men’s race with 44 points over No. 23 Colby (65) and No. 17 Tufts (88), though Colby’s Stephen White won the race in 24:00.2, 0.8 seconds ahead of MIT’s Dylan Fiegener. No. 7 Tufts won the women’s title with 42 points ahead of No. 9 MIT (68) and No. 21 Bates (75), and Bates freshman Charlotte Crum won the women’s race in 21:08.2.
